sql: SELECT p.id FROM people p LEFT JOIN (SELECT e.person_id, count(*)::float8 AS v FROM events e WHERE e.workspace_id = $1 AND e.name = $2::text GROUP BY e.person_id) a0 ON a0.person_id = p.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT e.person_id, count(*)::float8 AS v FROM events e WHERE e.workspace_id = $1 AND e.name = $2::text AND e.occurred_at > $6::timestamptz AND e.occurred_at <= $5::timestamptz GROUP BY e.person_id) a1 ON a1.person_id = p.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT e.person_id, count(*)::float8 AS v FROM events e WHERE e.workspace_id = $1 AND e.name = $2::text AND e.occurred_at > $4::timestamptz AND e.occurred_at <= $5::timestamptz GROUP BY e.person_id) a2 ON a2.person_id = p.id WHERE p.workspace_id = $1 AND p.merged_into IS NULL AND ((COALESCE((COALESCE(a0.v, 0::float8) = $3::float8), false) AND p.id IN (SELECT e.person_id FROM events e WHERE e.workspace_id = $1 AND e.name = $2::text AND e.occurred_at > $4::timestamptz AND e.occurred_at <= $5::timestamptz GROUP BY e.person_id HAVING count(*)::float8 > $3::float8) AND COALESCE((COALESCE(a1.v, 0::float8) <= $7::float8), false) AND COALESCE((COALESCE(a2.v, 0::float8) <> ALL($8::float8[])), false)))
